description: This PHP script manages custom fields assignment to test projects in the TestLink open source testing tool. It handles user actions such as assign, unassign, reorder, and toggle boolean attributes of custom fields linked to test projects, and generates the GUI for managing these associations.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Creates an object with all user inputs from the request, initializing test project info.

methods.name: getTproj
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the test project ID and name based on request/session data.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI data structure with locations, linked custom fields, and allowed node types.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to manage custom fields.

methods.name: createLocationsMenu
methods.description: Creates a menu of locations for custom fields based on item types.

methods.name: doRequiredMgmt
methods.description: Manages the required attribute of custom fields for a test project.

methods.name: doActiveMgmt
methods.description: Manages the active attribute of custom fields for a test project.

methods.name: doMonitorableMgmt
methods.description: Manages the monitorable attribute of custom fields for a test project.

methods.name: doSimpleBooleanMgmt
methods.description: Handles boolean attribute management (like required, active, monitorable) for custom fields.
